title: Initial work-tape configuration
statement: For Boolean lists $x$ and $out$, a state $s$ of the specified seven-state set, and a natural number $i$, define a configuration on input $x$ with state $s$, input-head position $1$, output $out$, and work-tape head at position $0$; the work tape contains the binary expansion of $i$ as its Boolean tape contents.
hypotheses_covered: State $s$ belongs to the specified seven-state set
